projects.name: Chinese Sentiment Analysis (Graduation Thesis)
projects.summary: Conducted research focusing on machine learning and attention mechanisms, utilizing a large-scale dataset of 60,000 text samples crawled from Weibo and Douban.
highlights: Implemented and evaluated four large language models (CNN, GNN, BERT, and BiRNN) for fine-grained sentiment classification.
Analyzed strengths and weaknesses across different corpora, with the BERT-based model achieving a peak accuracy of 94.5% and an F1 score of 0.93.
